day_focus: Look back on this week's progress and ministry outreach, then put one concrete half-step on Boaz's formation before his 15th birthday Sunday.
checkin: Son, Throwback Thursday isn't for thrashing the board — it's for seeing what God already moved. Proven Men landed well, the Commander's Intent work got printed, and the household still needs your presence more than another push. With Boaz three days from fifteen, don't invent a big program; review what's working, then take one honest half-step on his school plan and Formation Binder, and keep Maria and the kids close while you do it.
